title: Serum fucosylated prostate-specific antigen (PSA) improves the differentiation of aggressive from non-aggressive prostate cancers.

screening.reason: The study reports that serum fucosylated PSA is elevated in aggressive prostate cancer and shows improved predictive power over native PSA, directly linking a glycan modification to a clinical phenotype. However, the abstract lacks quantitative performance metrics (e.g., AUC, sensitivity/specificity) and sample size details, so full text is needed to assess biomarker validity.

title: Structural properties of a viral orthologue of cellular CD200 protein: KSHV vOX2.

screening.reason: The abstract describes structural characterization of a viral glycoprotein and its glycosylation sites, but does not link any glycan feature to a disease diagnosis, prognosis, or treatment response in humans or models.

title: Salivary protein glycosylation as a noninvasive biomarker for assessment of glycemia.

screening.reason: The study evaluates salivary protein glycosylation as a glycan-based biomarker for short‑term glycemic control in type 2 diabetes, linking a glycan feature to a clinical phenotype with quantitative correlations. Full text is needed to identify the specific glycan motifs, structures, and detailed performance metrics.

title: Phosphoneurofilament heavy chain and N-glycomics from the cerebrospinal fluid in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.

screening.reason: The abstract reports a specific increase in CSF N‑glycans (A2G2S(6)1 and FA2G2S(3)1) in ALS patients versus controls, providing a clear glycan biomarker candidate with statistical evidence (p=0.0348) and sample sizes.
